title: Astrid and the Inheritance
author: Jude Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
